$comment: Entry schema for contributes.languages (declarative and process plugins). A new language id needs aliases and may name a strict-JSON Monaco Monarch grammar and a language configuration file; a built-in (reserved) id only accepts extensions, filenames and filenamePatterns. The desktop host validates the grammar structure (states, rules, includes, cases, no log actions or dynamic regexes) and the configuration allowlist; the frontend compiles the regexes and rejects catastrophic backtracking.
description: Editor languages: file associations, Monarch grammars and language configurations (strict JSON).

id.description: Monaco language id. Built-in ids (contract reservedIds, for example json or python) are association-only.

aliases.description: Display names; required for a new language id and not allowed for a built-in id.

extensions.description: File extensions including the dot, for example .acme. Extensions of built-in languages are not overridden.

filenames.description: Exact file names, for example Acmefile.

filenamePatterns.description: Glob patterns ending in a literal extension, for example **/*.acme.json.

grammar.description: Package-relative Monaco Monarch grammar file (strict JSON), for example syntaxes/acme.json.

configuration.description: Package-relative language configuration file (strict JSON), for example languages/acme.configuration.json.

languagesFilenamePattern.description: An exact name/path or a glob whose literal suffix after the last wildcard contains a dot (not *, **/* or *.*).
